summary: MicroTouch produces capacitive touchscreen hardware for hospitality and QSR use, including Outdoor Open Frame displays (10.1", 21.5", 27" models, 1,500-nit brightness, IP66-rated) built for drive-thru kiosks, menu boards, and digital signage, plus rugged mobile tablets and all-in-one touchscreen POS computer systems.

MicroTouch markets rugged outdoor touchscreen products specifically aimed at retail and QSR self-service and drive-thru use cases, positioning ordering-accuracy and line-reduction benefits from interactive menu boards and self-service kiosks.
